data.context: In WIPO’s *Global Innovation Index 2026*, in “Matching deep science startups to global patent data,” this passage reports patent-family matching coverage for the tracker’s full universe of VC-backed deep science startups and spinouts, compared with a sample of non-deep science VC-backed startups. It notes which sectors show more or less patent activity and refers readers to the WIPO Technology SPARK report for detailed coverage by sector, economy and stage.
